parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name for which you want to modify the acceleration region.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description:
The acceleration region that you want to set. {"coverage":"overseas"} specifies regions outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values of coverage:

*   domestic: regions in the Chinese mainland.
*   overseas: regions outside the Chinese mainland.
*   global: regions in and outside the Chinese mainland.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-domain-schdm-by-property --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_global --region cn-hangzhou
